Restaurants Dining Facilities At Our Hotels and Resorts

Dining Facilities At Our Hotels and Resorts

We believe that food is not just a combination of ingredients but an art. And like all art it must delight the partaker. Our restaurants from all over India have consistently received high ratings from food connoisseurs and our patrons always drop in when in town. Have a look!

Luxurious Hotel & Resort, Goa

Since 2000, working with only the best food suppliers like small family farms, ensuring that we always have the best and always fresh ingredients to prepare our popular dishes. You’ll find a large variety of dishes made to satisfy any taste from traditional cuisine, a variety of natural soups, pasta, salads, finest desserts and beverages.

Luxury Heritage Hotel, Jaipur

We believe in traditional cooking and ingredients with purpose, and discovering ways which bring Local flavours and innovation in our food, rephrasing the definition of “Indian food” to a new wave of modern Indian cuisine which is a perfect example of old wine in new bottle.

Luxury Hotel Suite, Mumbai

The Spice food restaurant is relaxed, unique and offers food with variations. A food is prepared by experienced chefs who treat the ingredients with purposeful meaning. We pride for our chosen ingredients devoid of any artificial element and additives. We always explores in preparing our food with organic flavours of vegetables and other flavoured ingredients to prepare our beverage items.
